name: shoilpikkabbo-backend
description: Production REST API for SHOILPIKKABBO e-commerce platform

scripts.build: prisma generate && tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('dist/src/server.js') && !fs.existsSync('dist/server.js')) fs.writeFileSync('dist/server.js', \"require('./src/server.js');\");"
scripts.start: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); if (process.env.DATABASE_URL && !process.env.DATABASE_URL.includes('localhost')) { try { console.log('Syncing database schema with Prisma...'); execSync('npx prisma db push --skip-generate', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch(e) { console.warn('Prisma db push warning:', e.message); } }" && node dist/src/server.js
